items.title: 68145_Jimmie Rowles oral history interview
items.q: And we're still doing it. We just played a very successful couple of weeks down here at Merkle's(?), and right now we're working at Hanratty's, just the two of us.

ctx.x: bit. And we're still doing it. We just played a very successful couple of weeks down here at Merkle's(?), and right now we're working at Hanratty's, just the two of us. Our plans are to... I would like to play... Instead of playing clubs, where... See, I'm sixty-six years old right now. And with this problem I have, I just can't work six nights a week, every night, and travel all over the place. I've got to work out some kind of thing where all I do is play concerts or go someplace for maybe one or two days, and…
But she's... You know, you've heard her play. She's probably one of the most marvelous trumpeters, for a woman... You very, very seldom hear a girl who can play like that.
